# filemarkptr

Marks a file pointer.

```ttl
filemarkptr <file handle>
```

## Remarks

Marks the current file pointer for an opened file specified by &lt;file handle&gt;.
The marked pointer can be recalled by the "[fileseekback](fileseekback.md)" command.

## Example

```ttl
filemarkptr fhandle
```

See also the example of "[filestrseek2](filestrseek2.md)" command.
